[ORGTREE RESTART NOTICE] The backend was restarted. This is an informational notice delivered to live agents so you know what code version went live.

Running build:
- Commit: runtime.restart_notice·object.commit (short: runtime.restart_notice·object.short)
- Backend PID: 3
- Started at: runtime.restart_notice·started_at, branch: runtime.restart_notice·branch

What you can do with this:
- If you were waiting on or verifying a deployed fix, check whether the running commit contains your changes with:
  git merge-base --is-ancestor <your-commit> runtime.restart_notice·object.commit
- If you need to be woken immediately with a turn on the NEXT restart, call orgtree_restart_wake.
- Otherwise, no action is needed; this notice is for your awareness.
